name: What should I do immediately after my property sustains storm damage?

mainEntity.name: What should I do immediately after my property sustains storm damage?

acceptedAnswer.text: After ensuring personal safety, the first step is to prevent further damage. This might involve temporary repairs like tarping a damaged roof or boarding up broken windows. Document the damage thoroughly with photos and videos for insurance purposes. Then, contact a professional restoration company for a comprehensive assessment and to begin the cleanup and repair process. Avoid entering areas with structural damage or electrical hazards until deemed safe.
acceptedAnswer.description: Prioritize safety, prevent further damage, document everything, and contact a professional restoration company for assessment.
